comparison.objective: Place two setting blocks, then lower and release a glass unit onto them without sill contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Large fragile-part alignment and supported lowering into a narrow frame channel.
comparison.success_condition: Blocks positioned on marks; glass centred, upright, released, stable, resting on both blocks; any sill touch fails.
comparison.reason: Tests sequenced support placement and damage-free glass lowering, not notch fracture by controlled impact or recovery of released fragments.
